decisions.decision:
Run `node app/scripts/probe-anonymity.mjs` on main and sort each of the 28 hits:
(1) Public vendor or our own domains (usetantra.com, api.usetantra.com, kie.ai, revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev, and similar) go on the allow list. Turn the VENDORS array (lines 89-100) into [domain, reason] pairs, with a one-line reason on every entry, old and new.
(2) Banned vendors (Instantly, HeyReach, SendGrid, Apollo, Calendly, GoDaddy, M365, ZeroBounce, NeverBounce, BuiltWith) come off the allow list. Remove their mentions from guides and playbook instead of allowing them.
(3) Rewrite any hit that names a client or a private source through the lane B anonymisation. Keep library text verbatim.
Don't touch the T-141 library hold. Re-run probe-anonymity until it reports 0 non-export and 0 export hits. Then run check-guides and run-chain. Merge, push, update INTEGRATOR_RUNBOOK baseline ('26 non-export hits' → 0), log in LOG.md, close.
decisions.why: probe-anonymity.mjs VENDORS list has no reasons, and Done-when requires them. The hits are vendor and guide URLs, not library figures, so T-141 doesn't block this. approved-vendor-stack bans the vendors listed above everywhere. b-from-c-vendor-url-allowlist request.
